_comment: Sky-driven shadows (docs/SHADOWS.md, src/render/shadow_sky.c). Curves are [[x, y], ...] with increasing x, clamped at both ends. Hot reload: saved changes apply within a second (shadows_sky_reload forces it). No shadow strength lives here: darkness = direct vs sky irradiance.

source._comment: Effective source angular radius = sqrt(disc^2 + haze^2 + veil^2 + fog^2 + precip^2) in degrees, capped at max_radius_deg.

clouds._comment: veil_tau: cloud cover -> optical depth of the uniform sheet (direct x exp(-tau / mu)), scaled by (1 - k + k x density). cumulus_tau: a full texel of the cloud shadow map. Cloud drift = weather wind x wind_aloft (m/s, at least wind_min).

cutoff._comment: Contrast C = direct / sky irradiance. The cast shadow fades from 1 at 'on' to 0 at 'off'; under 'off' the passes stop and come back above off x (1 + reenable). smooth_s: time constant of radius / fade changes.

filter._comment: wide_deg: past this radius (full PCSS tier) cascade 0 fades out and the wide blur samples cascade 1. pcf_step_deg: the Off / Low tiers' 1 tap -> 3x3 -> 5x5 thresholds. era_pcf: the 2010 era's fixed PCF radius. pcss_max_texels: max filter half width per softness tier (PCF / limited / full).

exposure._comment: EV compensation added to the auto exposure: effective cloud cover, snow cover (summed).

ground._comment: Albedo of the ground half of the sky probe (bounce light into shadows).
